title: http.registry.contract.submit.v1.request
description: Submit a runtime contract declaration for governance gate check and durable registration (303-US6, #2237). Fields mirror ContractMeta / EndpointsMeta / SchemaRefsMeta so the gate runs the same curated declaration rules (CH-01 ownerCell, CH-02 lifecycle, CH-03 HTTP schemaRefs, REG-01 fanout completeness) as `gocell validate`. The submitter identity is taken from the authenticated principal, never the body.

id.description: Registration identifier (the contract id, e.g. http.example.foo.v1); dedup key within a tenant. A duplicate id yields 409.

kind.description: Contract kind. FMT-08 requires the id prefix to match (e.g. http.* for kind=http).

ownerCell.description: Owning cell id (CH-01). Must be a valid no-dash cell id.

lifecycle.description: Contract lifecycle stage (CH-02 / FMT-01). draft = not yet serving; active = production; deprecated = retiring.

consistencyLevel.description: Consistency level of the contract (optional; inferred by governance if omitted).

transports.description: Wire transports (optional; defaults to kind-specific transport when omitted, mirroring NormalizeRuntimeContract).

endpoints.description: Kind-specific endpoint declarations. Mirror of EndpointsMeta yaml fields (REG-01 provider/consumer completeness).

actorSubscribers.description: Actor (external) subscribers for kind=event (NormalizeRuntimeContract derives Subscribers from this).

schemaRefs.description: JSON Schema file references (CH-03: http contracts require schemaRefs.response).

response.description: Response schema ref (required for kind=http by CH-03).

payloadSchema.description: Opaque payload-schema reference/hash recorded at submit; uninterpreted by the gate (retained for US5 PG store).
